mentions.name: JetWriter
mentions.description: Chrome extension that lets users chat with web pages, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, and summarize pages. Supports models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, and allows using your own API key.
mentions.problem: Provides AI assistance for people who don't want to switch to AI browsers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For those who don't want to switch to AI browsers, I built a chrome extension that lets you chat with page, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, summarize page, etc. 
You can use models not just from OpenAI but also from Google and Anthropic.

Yes, you can use your own API key as well.
mentions.author: jerrygoyal
